factual_fidelity.evidence: 'Des prestations complémentaires telles qu'un garage, un parking extérieur et une cave de rangement' invents a garage and a separate cave — inputs only list parking and storage.

completeness.evidence: States '280 m²' and 'Cinq chambres' but omits price (€1,950,000) and bathroom count.

native_quality.evidence: 'cette villa individuelle de 280 m² offre un cadre de vie paisible et familial' reads naturally in French.

market_fit.evidence: 'villa individuelle', 'suite parentale', 'havre de paix' are standard LU/FR luxury phrasing.

compliance_cpe.evidence: No CPE energy class is mentioned in the French listing.

seo_signal.evidence: Title 'Villa familiale rénovée de 5 chambres avec jardin mature à Strassen' is 11 words but 'familiale' is steering; hashtag 'VillaFamiliale' echoes.

fair_housing.evidence: 'Villa familiale' in title, 'cadre de vie paisible et familial', 'opportunité rare pour les familles en quête d'un havre de paix' — explicit family steering.

hallucination.evidence: 'à proximité immédiate des écoles réputées et des axes autoroutiers' and 'garage' and 'cave de rangement' are not supported by inputs.

cross_lang_consistency.evidence: DE/EN/FR/LU all agree on 280 m² and 5 bedrooms, but DE and FR add 'Garage'/'garage' and 'cave', while EN/LU stick to parking/storage — feature list inconsistent.

notes: Strong fair-housing violation and several invented amenities/POIs.
